question: Ano ang Certificate of Completion of Subdivision at sinong ahensya ang nag-eendorse nito sa DHSUD?
answer: Wala akong impormasyon bahin sa Citizens' Charter tungkol sa Certificate of Completion of Subdivision na nag-eendorse nito sa DHSUD. Ang Certificate of Completion of Subdivision ay nakalaman sa [S1], ngunit wala ito nakit-an na nag-eendorse nito sa DHSUD.

ground_truth: The Certificate of Completion of Subdivision (COC) is a resolution from the City Housing Land Use and Regulatory Unit (CHLURU) favorably endorsing to DHSUD/HLURB that the project has been fully completed according to approved engineering plans.
